title: Add deck search endpoint
description:
Adds `GET /api/decks/search` so the deck list page can filter by name instead of loading every deck and filtering client-side (#508).

- `DeckRepository.search(ownerId, term, sortColumn)` runs a single `ILIKE` query, capped at 50 rows
- The route accepts `q` (search term), `sort` (column to order by, defaults to `updated_at`) and an optional `ownerId`, which support staff use to look at a ticket's decks without impersonating the user; it falls back to the session user
- Route test covers the happy path and asserts the repository is called with the session user

Performance: the `decks.name` index already exists from #431, so the new query plan is unchanged.
